# Complete report witness

The generator declares measured rows directly: two theta = 40 + i degrees, intensity = 20 + 7i,
and uncertainty = 2 + i modulo 5, for i from zero through 136. These are input values, not app
output. A constant background of six and zero structure scale isolate presentation from the engine.
The three-site FeO₂ cubic structure retains two Fe–O bonds and an O–O bond from the independent Structure
feature input, keeping all supported structure controls available without unrelated scene complexity. The native
long-table witness omits structure categories entirely; chart input and saved-HTML witnesses cover them separately.

The native witness edits actual Report Contents and Export controls, visits the final table row,
and saves self-contained HTML. The browser reads that disk document, observes every table row,
and clicks the actual chart buttons. Published Main powder palette colours provide the separate
style reference. Browser observation never changes chart data or calls a replacement chart API.

Each browser case exercises one viewport to avoid rendering an unrelated second copy in the same case. Linux structure
checks reuse the native gates' Xwayland/Mesa display with the installed browser and observe actual WebGL draws.
The default two-viewport observer contract is retained and independently replayed.
